evidence.quote: **Protection against web application layer DDoS attack vectors** – Web application layer DDoS attacks are best mitigated using a combination of application scale and a web application firewall (WAF).

Shield Advanced uses web request inspection logs from AWS WAF to detect anomalies that can be mitigated either automatically or via engagement with the AWS Shield Response Team (SRT). Automatic mitigation is available through deployed AWS WAF rate-based rules and also through the Shield Advanced automatic application layer DDoS mitigation.
